2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. By order dated 22.07.2024, this matter was referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre to resolve the dispute between the parties.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The learned Mediator vide its report dated 25.10.2024 has, inter alia, reported that a settlement has been arrived at between the parties as per the terms and conditions as mentioned in the report.

5. As the dispute has already been resolved between Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30414 of 2024(4) dt.12-11-2024 the parties, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Md.
